articleTitle: Switching Loss Analysis and Efficiency Comparison of DS-LCL and L2CL-LCL Compensation Systems in Wireless Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) is a hastily emerging area with enormous promise across many industries. This paper compares with the double sided LCL (DS-LCL) and a special compensation of L2CL-LCL compensation system in WPT by using MATLAB simulation. This paper also explains how the efficiency is improved in the L2CL-LCL system compared with DS-LCL. L2CL-LCL system can easily achieve Zero Current Switching (ZCS) and Zero Power Angle (ZPA). It can simultaneously reduce inverter current stress and compensate for reactive power. In a conventional DS-LCL configuration, the recorded output power is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$182.4W$</tex>, while the input power registers at 200.1 W. In both cases, the power dissipated in the driving circuit is assumed to be 2.1 W. The end-to-end efficacy of the DS-LCL model is calculated to be 90.10%. For the L2CL-LCL system, input and output power are calculated to be 224.2 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$211.05W$</tex>, respectively. Through the reduction of switching losses, the overall efficacy of the L2CL- LCL system can be raised to 93.2%. In the DS-LCL and L2CL-LCL systems, on-and-off switching losses are also computed.

articleTitle: Closed Loop Control of Three Level NPC Induction Motor Drive for Water Pumping Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Induction motor drives are significantly more affordable and reliable than traditional motor drives which are used in water pumping application. In this paper a full induction motor drive is constructed with a sinusoidal pulse width modulation fed multilevel inverter modulation method for pumping applications. These inverters are the industry standard for use in high voltage and power applications because they can transmit significant power without endangering machinery. An analysis of a conventional Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) multilevel inverter with five levels is also included in this study. A three level Space Vector Modulation is used to feed this inverter to an induction motor for a water pumping application. Pump Load is represented mathematically and observed its performance.

articleTitle: Detection of Water Quality in Sediment Filter for Water Purification System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Efficient water purification is vital for ensuring access to clean and safe drinking water. One essential component of water purification systems is the sediment filter, responsible for removing particulate matter and debris from the water. Monitoring and maintaining the performance of sediment filters are critical to guarantee the overall effectiveness of the water purification process. This study focuses on the development of a detection method to assess the water quality within sediment filters. The proposed detection method combines advanced sensing technologies and data analysis techniques to continuously evaluate the sediment filter's efficiency and identify potential issues. The system can promptly detect deviations from optimal performance by integrating real-time monitoring of key water quality parameters, such as turbidity, sediment concentration, and pressure differentials. Additionally, machine learning algorithms are employed to analyze the collected data, enabling the system to predict sediment filter clogging and degradation trends.

articleTitle: Leakage Reduction on Universal Gates Using ONOFIC Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: In order to meet the growing demand for energy-efficient digital systems, this study explores the crucial problem of leakage current in VLSI circuit design with an emphasis on low-power solutions. The increase in the number of battery-operated gadgets, wireless communication systems, and multifunctional electronics highlights the necessity for creative ways to reduce leakage power in CMOS devices. Power efficiency has become a critical consideration alongside the traditional concerns of performance, area, and cost. In order to reduce leakage current, the study presents a unique circuit-level methodology called ONOFIC (On/Off logIC), with a focus on its application to common universal gates such as NAND and NOR. The integration of a logic circuit between the pull-up and pull-down networks effectively manages leakage current in both active and standby modes, as demonstrated by the ONOFIC technique. The design of two-input NAND and NOR gates serve as an example of the approach, demonstrating notable power consumption savings over traditional designs. According to the experimental findings, the ONOFIC approach reduces leakage power for NAND and NOR gates by 85.08% and 73.66%, respectively. This research contributes new perspectives to the ongoing discourse on robust and efficient VLSI circuit design, offering promising strategies to enhance energy efficiency in digital circuits. The results continue the search for lower leakage power in advanced technology nodes by pointing to possible uses in a variety of combinational and sequential circuits.

articleTitle: Innovating with Arduino and Unity: Building Bridges Between Physical and Digital Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Arduino electronics and Unity software work together to revolutionize creativity and technology. This partnership breaks down barriers to integrate physical and digital worlds. Developers may now create immersive simulations, dynamic games, and experiential art that blur the lines between reality and virtuality. Use Arduino microcontrollers in Unity's flexible environment to have your works react to real-world inputs, ushering in a new age of interactive storytelling and immersive learning. This combination of hardware and software advances IoT, VR, and educational technologies and encourages creativity and innovation. As the physical and intangible blur, a universe of unlimited possibilities awaits pioneers to explore new frontiers of imagination.

articleTitle: Green Cloud: Navigating to a SustainableFuture Through Green Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Green Cloud Computing (GCC) is an innovative technology that has captured increasing attention in recent years due to its limitless possibility to revolutionize the field of sustainable cloud computing and subsequently reduce the impact of cloud computing on the environment. This paper introduces the concept of GCC and discusses its significance in addressing the harmful impact of cloud computing on the environment. It highlights the various approaches used for implementation and the existing work in the field of Green Cloud Computing.It finishes by discussing the hurdles faced and opportunities connected with its implementation.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Power and Hardware Utilization of FPGA Using RSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Cryptography significantly improves the security of digital communication and information in many different domains. The Kintex-7 FPGA series is used to develop a cryptographic method in the current research. In this research work evaluate two FPGA families-Genesys and Kintex-to find out which one uses the least amount of electricity. The Genesys family's power consumption was a mere 0.333 watts, in comparison to the Kintex family's 2.107 watts. On average, a Kintex member experiences 58.8 degrees Celsius, whereas a Genesys member experiences 53.2 degrees Celsius. Genesys offers better energy efficiency than other FPGA families, according to this paper. By using this strategy, energy sources may be saved for later use. Also, consider that the Kintex7 board is inexpensive than the Genesys2.

articleTitle: Industrial Automation and Implementation of Coconut Breaking System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: The coconut breaking machines have brought a revolutionary improvement to the dehusking process since it automate the removal of coconut meat from the hard shell. An overview of the features, benefits, and design of a coconut breaking machine created especially for de-husked coconuts is given in this study. Numerous advantages of the equipment include higher processing capacity, lower labour costs, increased effectiveness, and reliable de-husking outputs. It has found use in agricultural cooperatives, coconut-related businesses, and industries that process coconuts. The goal of this project is to process de-husked coconuts quickly and effectively, with no need for physical labour. To produce exact and reliable de-husking results, the machine combines mechanical and automated operations. This research offers a novel method for effectively and automatically dehusking coconuts. Its superior functions and design elements help to increase productivity, decrease the need for labour, and boost overall processing effectiveness.efficiently process coconuts that have been dehusked, minimising processing time and the need for manual labour. To produce exact and reliable de-husking results, the machine combines mechanical and automated operations.

articleTitle: Utilizing Cutting-Edge Deep Learning Strategies and Harnessing the Power of a Pre-Trained ResNet18 Convolutional Neural Network for Assessing the Risk of Autism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: In this study, the ResNet18 CNN classification method, a machine learning algorithm explored herein, is employed for the assessment of an individual's likelihood of developing autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The investigation utilizes a diverse dataset encompassing various factors, including behavioral traits, demographic information, and clinical markers associated with ASD. Leveraging the simplicity and effectiveness of the ResNet18 CNN technique in classification tasks, the study scrutinizes patterns within the dataset to make predictions regarding the probability of autism. The research initiates with the initial phase of data preparation, involving processes such as feature selection and normalization, aimed at optimizing the model's performance. Subsequently, a comprehensive evaluation of the ResNet18 CNN method is conducted, considering different hyperparameter configurations and assessing its effectiveness in accurately categorizing individuals into ASD and non-ASD groups. The results showcase the algorithm's efficacy in identifying subtle patterns within the dataset, thereby enhancing our understanding of the factors influencing the risk of autism. The implications of this study extend beyond diagnostic applications, as the precision of the model established here has the potential to assist clinicians and researchers in early identification and intervention for individuals at risk of ASD. This work contributes significantly to ongoing efforts focused on improving the accuracy and effectiveness of autism risk assessment through the integration of machine learning approaches. Ultimately, the goal of this research is to facilitate timely and targeted therapies, leading to improved outcomes in the realm of autism.

articleTitle: Object Localization and Recognition in High Resolution Satellite Image Using U-Net in CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative approach to localize and recognize objects in high-resolution satellite images, integrating U-Net into a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) framework. Effectively addressing challenges in detecting and classifying objects within intricate satellite datasets, our method leverages U-Net for precise object localization, capturing intricate spatial details. The CNN enhances recognition by hierarchical feature extraction. Demonstrating superior performance in accurate identification and delineation of objects, our model holds immense potential for applications in remote sensing, urban planning, and environmental monitoring. The integration of U-Net within the CNN establishes a robust solution, contributing significantly to advancements in computer vision for satellite-based applications. This research marks a noteworthy stride in developing sophisticated techniques for object localization and recognition in high-resolution satellite imagery.

articleTitle: Ferranti Effect on a pi model of an Overhead Transmission Line - A detailed Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This paper deals with the design and findings of a novel laboratory model developed to enable hands-on evaluation of the Ferranti Effect on transmission lines. The Ferranti effect is defined as a steady voltage at the open end of an uncompensated transmission line being larger than the voltage at the sending end. The salient feature of this work is its empirical basis, achieved by experimentation on hardware with a power generator and an advanced double bus bar system. The experimental analysis aims at voltage regulation and the observation of voltage profiles on transmission lines. The experiment further identifies the capacitive and inductive properties of the line as pivotal factors in the manifestation of the Ferranti Effect, particularly under conditions of light load or open circuits at the receiving end. This study enhances the practical understanding of transmission line phenomena, offering valuable insights for power engineering education and highlighting the importance of laboratory prototype in validating theoretical concepts.

articleTitle: State of Health Estimation for Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on Charging Curve and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Among the best crucial tasks of the BMS (battery management system) is estimating the state of health (SoH) which ensures the safe and reliable use of lithium-ion batteries. This paper shows an effective method for estimating the SOH of lithium ion batteries. In order to estimate SoH, a regression approach using the health factor and SoH is created through analyzing what battery's charging data analysis throughout the period of its service life. This method requires minimal learning and is easily applied in practical applications in chemistry or cell structure. Instead of using an entire charging voltage range, The time it takes to charge between two defined voltage levels is used to figure out the health parameter. Based on the regression model's goodness of fit, the voltage level is chosen for health prediction. The accuracy of the regression line is found to be over 99% when tested using a variety of test data.

articleTitle: Ocean Wings-Human Identification Using Drone for Sea Rescue Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This study explores the application of YOLOv8, a state-of-the-art object detection algorithm, for human detection in open water using drones in Search and Rescue (SAR) operations. Open water environments present unique challenges for human detection due to dynamic conditions, limited visibility, and the vastness of the area. Drones equipped with SAR sensors and YOLOv8 offer a promising solution to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of search and rescue missions. The research involves the development of a specialized model based on YOLOv8 architecture, fine-tuned for human detection in open water scenarios. A dataset comprising diverse open water images is used for training and validation, ensuring the robustness of the model across various conditions. The drone's capabilities, including real-time data transmission and high maneuverability, are leveraged to conduct simulated SAR missions in open water environments.

articleTitle: Embedded Floating Bag for Military Use
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to develop an innovative Suspended Floating Bag (SFB) for military load carriage which is meant as a solution to problems associated with conventional backpacks. This excess weight exposes infantry soldiers to higher levels of energy expenditures associated with decreased performance. This load is controlled by one of the mechanisms used in the SFB which comprises springs, pulleys, and elastic ropes that suspend and minimize the vertical displacement thereby reducing movement within the structure. In addition, these products feature a lightweight and strong frame coupled with rack and pinion for enhanced stability and precision. Real-time location tracking and anti-theft function supported by embedded technologies such as Arduino Uno micro utility controller, Global Positioning System (GPS), Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) modules, and buzzer system. Furthermore, it is also fitted into a self-sustaining power generation system by way of a rack and pinion as well as a dynamometer. Reduction in vertical excursion and total ground reaction force during field trials provides an enduring solution and diminishes the likelihood of conventional back pain. The research has thus made progress in the development of load carriage systems that could improve endurance as well as the comfort of military forces during critical engagements off the battlefield.

Author Keywords: Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) system

articleTitle: Performance Evolution of Switched Capacitor Boost Nine Level Inverter with Variable Frequency APOD Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: As electrical power has existed, power quality has been an issue, and in recent years, academics have focused mostly on this issue. Harmonic reduction in inverters is necessary because harmonics play a significant role in power quality and reliable power supply performance. Additionally, this study uses an inventive inverter design that produces 9-level output voltage waveforms using 1 DC source, 8 switches, and 3 capacitors. This Pulsewidth modulation (PWM) technique examines a multicarrier approach that is being used with the Variable frequency alternative phase opposition disposition (VF-APOD) for a nine-level inverter. After being obtained, the comparison is made between the conventional approach and the line voltage and total harmonic distortion (THD). Also, this study generates gating signals using the PWM approach, guaranteeing the improved output waveforms. The study also includes numerous simulation results obtained using MATLAB-SIMULINK, offering a full assessment of the proposed configuration's precise effectiveness under distinct modulation index.

articleTitle: In-Depth Analysis of Exploratory Data Utilizing an InceptionV3 Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Framework and Deep Learning Techniques for Predicting the Quality of Red Wine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This research delves into the crucial role of the Exploratory Data Processing (EDP) phase as a fundamental initial step in predicting red wine quality through the application of an InceptionV3 Cnn technique within the realm of Machine Learning. The dataset encompasses a diverse array of chemical attributes and sensory elements inherent to red wines. The Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) process involves a comprehensive examination of the data, encompassing meticulous scrutiny, data purification, and rigorous statistical analysis, all geared towards ensuring data integrity and quality. Visualizations play a pivotal role in facilitating the identification and exploration of patterns and connections within the provided information. Feature engineering and dimensionality reduction techniques are employed to enhance the model's predictive capabilities. The choice of the InceptionV3 Cnn algorithm is motivated by its interpretability and ability to capture non-linear interactions. The performance of the trained model is evaluated using established criteria to validate its robustness and generalization capabilities. The EDP-centric methodology employed in this study establishes the groundwork for an advanced and precise prediction framework for evaluating red wine quality, offering valuable insights to the wine industry.

articleTitle: Utilizing SVM, CNN to predict Alzheimer's disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This abstract outlines a bioinformatics research endeavor focused on unraveling the intricate relationship between genes and age-related diseases, with a specific emphasis on Alzheimer's disease. The primary methodology involves the development of a classification model aimed at categorizing each gene, a fundamental step in understanding the genetic basis of diseases. To achieve this, this paper employed two distinct machine learning architectures: Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), both renowned for their efficacy in classification tasks. Prior to inputting data into these models, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is utilized for feature extraction, a technique aimed at simplifying the dataset while retaining crucial information. This research endeavors to contribute to our understanding of Alzheimer's disease by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques to decipher the intricate genetic signatures associated with this debilitating condition.

Author Keywords: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes(KEGG)

articleTitle: Enhancing Your Car-Buying Experience: Augmented Reality for Color Customization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: A big component of the exhilarating but difficult car-buying process is colour. Buying a vehicle is being changed by AR technology, which gives additional alternatives. This abstract suggests the use of AR to modify automotive hues. Car dealerships utilised booklets and colour swatches to offer consumers what hues to choose. These approaches are restricted and don't effectively reflect a colour on a small automobile. Using AR technology, customers may realistically determine the hue of their desired car. With AR, clients may view a broad array of hues on a tablet, smartphone, or showroom display. In order to more correctly show the automobile type and colour, this technology provides a 360-degree image and simulates real-life illumination. You may rapidly share personalised sets with friends and family, compare alternatives, and adjust the hues. Beyond looks, AR colour customization is available. Find out more about colour availability, upkeep, and market worth. The increased data supports customers in making well-informed selections that correspond with their requirements and preferences. For a more individualised experience, vehicle firms may enable augmented reality colour customization. This technology makes choice easier and minimises regret after a purchase, as it allows consumers to be certain of their options before completing a purchase.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Post Harvest Seed Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: A modern drying technologies are included in this self-contained unit's movable platform to effectively reduce moisture in newly harvested paddy. The system achieves ideal moisture levels for secure storage and further processing by combining regulated heat application, exact ventilation mechanisms, and real-time moisture monitoring. Its portability is a fundamental benefit, enabling deployment in agricultural locations with a variety of topography and limited resources. The difficulties presented by smallholder farmers without access to fixed drying infrastructure are addressed by this flexibility. The system's architecture places a high priority on usability, combining intuitive user interfaces and automatic controls that ease setup and maintenance. It reduces the possibility of mold growth and mycotoxin contamination through faster moisture evaporation, maintaining grain integrity and nutritional value. The mobile seed processing system makes a substantial contribution to improving food security, lowering post-harvest losses, and promoting sustainable agriculture practices on a worldwide scale.

articleTitle: Annapoorna – Food, Water and Medicine Delivery Teleoperated Robot with Telemedicine Facility
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Annapoorna is a tele-operated robot to deliver food, water, and medicines to COVID patients in isolation wards. It is equipped with a telemedicine facility for doctors and nurses to interact with patients remotely. This greatly reduces direct contact of doctors, nurses, and food service staff with patients during COVID or other pandemic times, thereby reducing infection risk. The battery powered robot reaches each bedside to serve food and medicines to the patients in isolation wards. The robot can be controlled by smartphone app or wireless joystick controller. The tablet attached at the top of the robot serves dual purpose. The doctors and nurses can interact with the patient with any online meeting portals like Skype, Google Hangout, Zoom etc. In addition, the operator can control the robot using the tablet camera there by saving additional cost for the camera.

articleTitle: Investigating the Impact of Temperature on the Photovoltaic Properties of CsSnI3-Based Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Cesium tin iodide (CsSnI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) demonstrates favorable attributes as a viable and cost-effective absorber material within the domain of lead-free perovskite solar cells (PSCs). The high light absorption capabilities of CsSnI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> render it highly efficient in converting solar energy into usable power. The high prevalence of cesium and tin contributes to their affordability. The persistence of lead toxicity and long-term stability concerns remains a challenge, however, ongoing research endeavors aim to address these challenges, hence enhancing the appeal of CsSnl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> PSCs as a viable contender in the field of solar energy. The main aim of this research is to investigate the impact of the temperature on the photovoltaic (PV) properties. The present study employed the 1D-SCAPS software to conduct the investigation. PSCs have emerged as a promising technology for the generation of sustainable energy, primarily due to their improved efficiency and cost-effectiveness in the production process. An investigation of how temperature changes affect the device's efficacy has been conducted. The ITO/PCBM/CsSnCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/Cul/Au device structure has been presented. The temperature fluctuates between 300 and 400 k, split into 10 equal intervals for this proposed investigation. The CsSnI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> material's band gap is determined to be 1.3 eV. The PV measurements that follow show the following values when the temperature is changed: PCE = 23.3%, the V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf> = 0.87 V, the J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf> = 30.76 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and the FF = 86.69%.

articleTitle: Combined Model Of Incineration And Dispenser For Sanitary Napkins
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: The proposed combined model aims to educate and increase awareness of using sanitary napkins in rural schools and faculties. It also proposes incinerators to reduce infection, environmental pollutants, and clogging of public drainage systems. The dispenser machines, which will accept coins, can be used in industries and contribute to an eco-friendly environment. The double-chamber design ensures hygienic disposal, while the device can also be used as plant fertilizer. The goal is to improve health and hygiene in rural areas. It is an automated machine that simplifies and smooths the process of disposing of sanitary napkins and dispensing new sanitary napkins. One compartment slot with 20 sanitary pads is designed in the dispenser. An incinerator can burn up to five pads in one iteration. The burning time and dispensing time are tabulated with satisfactory results. The incinerator and dispenser are designed using an Arduino UNO, a 4-channel relay, a control relay, a DC servo motor, An LCD display is used to indicate the status of sanitary napkins; a nickel heating coil is used to burn the napkins; and a nickel-coated spring is used to store the napkins. This machine is operated with less emission and consumed power supply, so it is fully eco-friendly and in a hygienic manner. It can be installed in schools, colleges, train compartments, railway stations, and public toilets for the betterment of society, and it also gives the best message toward the “Swachh Bharat Mission.”

articleTitle: Predicting Warehouse Location of Online Shopping Platforms with Machine Learning Algorithm – A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Online shopping has turned into the most convenient way to purchase products as it is more user friendly and the availability of the product is vast and also the range of products that the customers can select is abundant. Due to increasing customers in online shopping platforms, it is necessary for efficient warehouse location selection strategies to meet the increasing demand of the customers. By ensuring that all products are available and cutting down on delivery times, warehouse location optimization can improve customer satisfaction, which in turn boosts sales on e-commerce platforms. Using a dataset containing the required parameters, a Machine Learning algorithm can be deployed to optimize the warehouse location of virtual shopping platforms by analysing the total number of orders in each location. Various algorithms, such as KNN, SVM, and Random Forest algorithm, can be used to predict whether there is a need for a warehouse in a particular location. This study aims to determine which algorithm is best suited for this model.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Speed Control of BLDC Motor Using Flyback Converter for Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This work presents the simulation of Closed-Loop Control (CLC) for a Brushless Direct Current (BLDC) motor used in an Electric Vehicle (EV) application. To regulate a BLDC motor, a variety of techniques are available. This work focuses on using fuzzy logic and flyback converter to for the speed control of brushless DC (BLDC) motors, which is used to drive the electric motors of fan, servo applications and other motion controls, because of their advantageous mechanical and electrical characteristics. The analysis of BLDC through simulation is performed using MATLAB and using the outcomes of the simulation, the motor's performance is examined. Using the created MATLAB/Simulink model, the dynamic characteristics of the brushless DC motor are monitored and studied. The simulation results are validated with hardware implementation.

Author Keywords: Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) and Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV)

articleTitle: GhoomAR: Experience the Rich Heritage and Culture using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: GhoomAR, an innovative augmented reality (AR) software, enhances Jaipur City's tourism experience while promoting the city's rich tradition and culture. GhoomAR effortlessly blends technology and tradition to provide tourists with an interactive platform beyond tourist guidebooks. The application brings Jaipur's history, architectural marvels, and cultural richness to life. GhoomAR is a cultural gateway and tourism companion. It connects past and present, helping visitors appreciate Jaipur's colorful customs, remarkable history, and architectural splendor. AR helps tourists connect with the city's history in a meaningful way. This app's importance goes beyond tourism. It is crucial to preserving and promoting Jaipur's culture. GhoomAR preserves the city's rich traditions and historical tales in a changing environment. By introducing tourists to Jaipur's rich culture, it fosters respect and enthusiasm for its traditions, art, and history. In an age where cultural preservation is crucial, GhoomAR is a powerful example of technology and tradition blending. It encourages travelers to enjoy Jaipur's beauty and promote its cultural treasures. It shows how technology can preserve and celebrate a place's tradition and culture, safeguarding Jaipur City's legacy for future generations.

articleTitle: A Context-Aware Emergency Assistance Chatbot Employing Recurrent Neural Networks for Personalized First Aid Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: A highly sophisticated chatbot designed to provide real-time assistance during emergencies and personalized guidance for administering medical treatment. This virtual assistant utilizes advanced Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) to offer insightful responses to user inquiries on various pressing scenarios. The model has undergone training using diverse datasets and utilizes advanced deep learning techniques, including incorporation and LSTM approach elements, to provide responses that are both coherent and comprehensive. The framework is specifically intended to provide flexible interactions that may be adjusted to suit the constantly evolving nature of emergency situations. In order to provide tailored advice, the chatbot flawlessly incorporates GPS position, user context, and real-time sensor data. Ensuring customer security and facilitating effective communication are the main goals of the chatbot. In addition to meeting immediate requirements, this effort helps enhance emergency response systems driven by artificial intelligence. The ability of RNN algorithms to mimic human behavior assistance during emergencies is shown.

articleTitle: Enhanced Classification of Turmeric Leaf Disease Severity Levels Using an Optimized Hybrid Deep Learning Model: LevelPrecisionRecallF1-scoreAccuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: During a study that was conducted in India on turmeric fields, researchers found that various types of turmeric had a prevalence of turmeric leaf spot disease ranging from 6% to 28%. Traditional methods for disease prediction in turmeric crops have several limitations, including high costs for procuring the data input mandatory to run the model, a lack of regional data, and an insufficient dataset. In this study, we investigate the Turmeric problem while also using the hybrid convolutional neural networks (CNN) with SVM for Leaf spot severity level classification. This study looks at the infection that may be found on turmeric leaves. First, the unhealthy plant is captured on camera with the help of secondary sources. To extract and categorize the characteristics of the sickness, CNN –SVM deep learning algorithms are employed to their fullest potential. The results of the research revealed an accuracy of 97% for the Leaf spot Turmeric Disease severity level classification.

articleTitle: Disturbance Estimation and Rejection in an Underwater Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: The smooth operation of an underwater autonomous vehicle requires proper navigation, which can be challenging due to the highly complex environment of the ocean. Unpredictable factors, such as fast-moving waves, underwater obstacles, and external phenomena, can negatively impact the system's overall performance. In this paper, the second-order dynamics of the underwater system was modelled and implemented for yaw control to reach a desired angle. To estimate the disturbances occurring in the system accurately, an integral observer was proposed and a PID controller was designed for proper disturbance rejection. A robustness analysis with the developed controller was also conducted. The simulated results show that the designed integral observer estimates the disturbances precisely, and the proposed PID controller is effective in proper rejection control in a second-order autonomous underwater system.

articleTitle: Android Based App Development for Remote Logging and Control with Smart Home Watering System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This article proposes a smart and efficient solution to the difficulties in plant watering experienced by people who enjoy growing plants in their homes but lead hectic lives, frequently travel for work, and frequently move homes, because such situations frequently make it difficult for them to continuously take care of their backyard gardens. The proposed methodology suggests an entirely automated solution to this problem, making sure that plants are watered properly even when the owner isn't home. This software supported smart device gives users the opportunity to keep an eye on the water levels in their plants and spot water supply interruptions brought on by either power outages or a lack of water. The system's potential also includes predictive intelligence, where it can analyze plant moisture levels, anticipate human behaviour, and choose the best times to water plants. The difficulties of caring for plants at home in a fast-paced environment are thus addressed by this novel approach, which shows promise.

Author Keywords: remote logging and control smart home watering system

articleTitle: Evaluating Resource Allocation Strategies in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks with Cloud Computing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Cellular advert Hoc Networks (MANETs) is self-organizing wireless networks that lack the physical infrastructure and centralized manage of conventional networks. With a purpose to enable powerful communiqué, it's miles important to deal with the resource allocation problem in MANETs. Recently, Cloud Computing algorithms were used to evaluate aid allocation techniques in MANETs. Those algorithms contain sampling strategies, which include nearest neighbor, Monte Carlo, and hybrid strategies, to optimize the useful resource utilization levels. This allows for a more correct assessment of the to be had assets in MANETs. Moreover, these algorithms also can be carried out to autonomously control and time table communication flows with a view to improve standard network performance. This paper affords an outline of the existing aid allocation techniques and their evaluation in MANETs the usage of cloud computing algorithms. It also discusses the impacts of the useful resource control selections in MANETs and the challenges confronted in deploying cloud computing algorithms in these settings. Lastly, a fixed of future studies directions is proposed to in addition improve resource allocation techniques in MANETs.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Drive Safety with Cloud-based Adaptive Cruise Control using K-Nearest Neighbors Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: An innovative new technique cloud-based adaptive cruise control (ACC) uses data analysis and cloud computing to make driving safer and more efficient. Current ACC systems in the cloud depend on static models or rules, to handle the ever-changing nature of traffic. It provide a data-driven method for ACC in the cloud that makes use of the k-nearest neighbours (KNN) algorithm to adapt the vehicle's speed and distance based on learning from both past and present driving data. For this ACC system in the cloud and develop a protocol for communication between vehicles and the cloud, as well as a distance and speed controller based on KNN. It tests the method against both traditional ACC and human drivers in a simulated environment to view how well it performs. In a number of traffic situations, the method outperforms both the human driver and traditional ACC in terms of safety, comfort, and fuel economy. The system's cloud-based architecture allows it to access and understand vast volumes of real-time data, providing drivers with an exhaustive and current data of the environment ahead. The system simulates real-world studies to test the effectiveness of the proposed method, demonstrating how it may improve road safety and traffic flow. When data-driven decision-making is combined with ACC it demonstrates how cloud-based technology may be used to improve road safety and advance the field of intelligent transportation.

articleTitle: IoT-based Flood Early Warning System for Effective Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Early flood warning systems help communities manage floods by giving accurate information. Recent developments using Internet of Things (IoT) offer early warning system to improve disaster management. A network of sensors collects important information such as rainfall intensity, water levels, and weather conditions. Based on this information, a cloud platform makes reliable flood forecasts and alerts. Traditional flood early warning systems need more benefits of the IoT-based solution. It allows for colleting sensor data and analyzes the real time monitoring in various locations, offering a complete perspective of flood-prone regions. These communications are given to the appropriate persons through various methods, such as mobile applications and alert notifications. It allows for continuous monitoring, which speeds up response times and evacuations. The system is flexible enough to allow more sensors and wider regions of coverage. In addition, it improves flood warning accuracy using IoT and real-time data processing. The system's ability to provide accurate flood alerts at the right moment offers great promise for enhancing disaster management. It communities to make informed decisions, reduces the number of deaths, and reduces floods' economic and social expenses.

articleTitle: An Investigation on Machine Learning Models in Classification and Identifications Cervical Cancer Using MRI Scan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This study analyzes the effectiveness of machine learning models in the classification of cervical cancer using a dataset of 900 cancer and 200 non-cancer images gathered from online resources and hospitals. The dataset, covering both CT and MRI images, undergoes rigorous preprocessing, including standardization, normalization, and noise reduction, to enhance its quality for model training. Four machine learning models, namely VGG16, CNN, KNN, and RNN, are recruited to predict cancer and non-cancer cases. During the testing phase, VGG16 emerges as the most accurate, achieving an impressive accuracy of 95.44%, followed by CNN at 92.3%, KNN at 89.99%, and RNN at 86.233%. Performance parameters, such as precision, recall, F1 score, and accuracy, are fully analyzed, providing insights into each model's strengths and capabilities. These discoveries not only contribute to the advancement of cervical cancer diagnostic techniques but also underscore the potential of machine learning in medical imaging. The study emphasizes the relevance of model selection and provides a framework for future research endeavors seeking to enhance the accuracy and performance of cervical cancer diagnosis through the merger of advanced computational techniques with standard diagnostic practices.

articleTitle: Stress Detection Using EEG Signals: A Review on Current Strategies and Future Aspects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Stress, a constant in modern life, harms mental and physical health. Electroencephalography (EEG) is useful for monitoring cerebral activity and identifying stress neural correlates because it is non-invasive. This review discusses EEG-based stress detection methodologies and future directions. The review begins with stress's physiological cause and EEG manifestation. It then discusses stress detection preprocessing, feature extraction, and machine learning algorithms. These methods include spectrum analysis, time-domain features, and deep learning models like CNN's, RNN's, and hybrid models. Stress detection systems benefit from data quality, artifact reduction, and feature selection. The paper also discusses EEG based stress detection in clinical diagnosis, occupational stress evaluation, and Brain-Machine Interface. It discusses real-world deployment issues and wearable EEG devices for continuous stress monitoring. Going ahead, the paper covers promising EEG stress detection technologies. This includes integrating multi modal data sources including physiological signals, eye-tracking, and behavioral data, creating tailored stress profiles, and using sophisticated machine learning and deep learning methods like transfer learning and AI.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Architectures for Alzheimer's Disease Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) continues to present a substantial challenge in modern healthcare, placing considerable burdens on individuals, families, and healthcare systems worldwide. The study investigates the efficacy of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures in the categorization of distinct phases of Alzheimer's disease using brain imaging data. The CNN model proposed in this study encompasses a multi-layered architecture, commencing with image preprocessing. Subsequently, convolutional, and pooling layers are employed, along with dropout regularization, to enhance the model's performance. Finally, fully connected layers are utilized for the purpose of classification. The study assesses the efficacy of different optimization algorithms, namely SGD, Adadelta, Adagrad, and Adam, over a span of 100 epochs. The training and validation graphs provide visual representations of the model's convergence and generalization abilities. It is observed that the Adam optimizer exhibits superior performance in terms of accuracy and loss. Furthermore, confusion matrices are utilized to illustrate the efficacy of different optimizers in accurately classifying individuals into the stages of “Mild Demented,” “Very Mild Demented,” “Non-Demented,” and “Moderate Demented.” The results indicate that the Adam optimizer achieves the highest accuracy and exhibits a lower number of misclassifications. The findings highlight the effectiveness of convolutional neural network (CNN) models, particularly when enhanced with the Adam optimization algorithm, in accurately categorizing various phases of Alzheimer's disease using brain imaging data. These results present encouraging prospects for clinical diagnosis and research in this field.

articleTitle: DriveQ: A Dedicated Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication System for Enhancing Road Safety and Traffic Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Modern urban transportation systems confront significant challenges, including escalating traffic congestion, accidents, and inefficient traffic management. One critical aspect contributing to these issues is the limited means of communication between vehicles, which represents a missed opportunity to en-hance road safety and traffic efficiency. To address these concerns and facilitate smarter transportation solutions, there's a need for an efficient, standardized, and secure Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication system capable of seamlessly sharing real-time data between vehicles. DriveQ mainly focuses on implementing a dedicated V2V communication system that enhances road safety and traffic management. V2V communication technology is a revolutionary development that depends on Dedicated Short-Range Communication (DSRC), a specialized communication method enabling vehicles to exchange critical information such as location, speed, and status in real-time. In addition to providing exceptionally low latency communication, DSRC is essential for broadcasting messages that improve road safety by facilitating quick and easy communication between vehicles. The system allows users to view and share real-time data and allows us to connect with nearby vehicles within a specific range. With the help of this function, drivers can take preventative measures to keep themselves safe. DriveQ has a broad range of applications including Stop Sign Movement Assistance, Forward Collision Warning, Pre-Crash Warning, and Curve Speed Warning.

articleTitle: Evolving Energy Landscapes: A Comprehensive Analysis of Renewable Power in the 21st Century
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This study explores the latest advancements in Renewable Energy, offers a comprehensive overview of the changing energy landscapes in India and United states through an examination of important variables, such as installed capacity, changes in electricity generation, and projections for the future. The study examines the distribution of energy sources, the growth of solar energy, wind power generation, net Renewable electricity capacity, and sales of electricity to final consumers by analysing data from reliable sources. Furthermore, the study projects how renewable energy technologies will develop in the future, focusing on the wind and solar industries and highlighting national and International initiatives. The Results highlight how important Renewable energy is to define Sustainable energy futures, resolving environmental issues, and promoting economic expansion. Subsequently, the Research reveals the complex dynamics of the production and consumption of electricity. Nuclear power is surpassed by the Renewable Energy industry overall, even with a fall in wind energy generation. The study goes on to examine more general patterns in American energy, emphasising the sharp decrease in coal output and the notable rise in small-scale solar photovoltaic generation. Future projections highlight the steady expansion of the solar photovoltaic sectors and a gradual decline in the installation of onshore wind power. A detailed analysis of power sales to final consumers, offering industry-specific insights into trends in Residential, Commercial, Industrial,and Transportation,rounds up the report.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model for EffectivePapaya Leaf Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Papaya production faces significant challenges as a result of numerous leaf diseases that impair yield and quality. This study focuses on the automated identification of prevalent papaya leaf diseases using a model for classification constructed using neural networks using convolution, often known as CNNs and Random Forest algorithms. The research includes an in- depth assessment of illness classification efficacy, with a focus on recall, precision, F1-score, support, and metrics for accuracy across a variety of groups, including PRSV, Dusty Mildew, bacterial Leaves Spot, which is Anthracnose and Black Spot, Cercospora The leaves Spot, as well as Angular Leaf Spot. The results show that the algorithm performs well, with precision values consistently exceeding 93% for each disease class. The high recall values of the model, which reach 92%, reflect its ability to detect true positive occurrences. The F1-score, which assesses the balance of recall and accuracy, frequently exceeds 94%, proving the persistence of the categorization model. The backing numbers offer data on the occurrence distribution of every illness in the dataset. The recommended model's effectiveness in differentiating between various papaya leaf ailments is evidenced by an average weighted precision of 94.49%. The micro, as well as macro averages, demonstrate the model's stability in performance across various courses, resulting in the micro average yielding a value of 94.49%. These findings help to develop automated assessment and treatment in papaya growing, providing farmers with a useful tool for making early and precise choices regarding management. The proposed methodology generates positive results, paving the path for better disease management and papaya yields.

articleTitle: Smart Signal Speed Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: The Smart Signal Speed Control System (SSSCS) is an intelligent traffic management solution designed to optimize traffic flow and enhance road safety. Traditional traffic signal systems often lack adaptability to dynamic traffic conditions, leading to inefficiencies and congestion. The SSSCS addresses these challenges by integrating real-time data from various sensors, communication technologies, and advanced algorithms to dynamically control traffic signals based on the current traffic environment. Key components of the SSSCS include a network of sensors, such as cameras, radar, and vehicle detection systems, deployed at strategic locations across the road network. These sensors continuously gather information on traffic density, vehicle speed, and other relevant parameters. The collected data is transmitted to a central control system, where advanced algorithms analyze the information in real time. The SSSCS represents a significant advancement in traffic management, leveraging smart technologies to create a responsive and adaptive system. By integrating real-time data, advanced algorithms, and vehicle communication, the system aims to transform traditional traffic signal control, leading to improved traffic flow, reduced congestion, and enhanced road safety.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization in Induction Furnaces and Rolling Mills for Medium-Scale Industries Through Energy Efficient Power Conversion Systems and Best Operational Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) industries contribute to a critical share of the nation's economy. The Indian economy is in a comparative scale of fifth position among the top five economies in the world. Even though MSMEs are small in size, their numbers are huge. Energy conservation and energy efficiency are related keys to sustainable and lean manufacturing processes in various industries, supplementing India's G20 commitments. Furnaces play a vital role in various types of MSMEs involved in the manufacturing of various products. Conserving the energy required for furnace and heat treatment operations plays a pivotal role in achieving monetary savings in such facilities. Energy audits help any such facility to observe the energy utilization patterns, scope of improvements in any process or machinery to derive energy savings, verify the observed data through scientific measurements and data surveys, data analytics, and state-of-the art engineering calculation methods to prove the suggested measures of improvements with the basic objective of bringing monetary savings in operational costs and a reduction in carbon footprints. The decarbonization of the industrial sector in India majorly depends on energy-efficient technologies and best operational practices. Fuel switching to electricity and renewable energy integration go hand in hand. Energy audits pan India helped us to explore a few such opportunities as discussed here substantiated with suitable case studies.

articleTitle: Cricket Player Prediction of Role in a Team Using ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Cricket is one of the most popular sports in the world. In India, admiration for cricket is very huge for playing and as well as in viewing. When considering the aspect of players, who wanted to represent their country in this sport is also high. So, a need arises to find an easy way to filter out the players considering their skills and talent. Therefore, one of the simple ways to achieve the above is by proposing the best ML model. The fundamental intention of this model is to design a sophisticated prototype that assists cricket team selectors in making smart decisions regarding player selection. By analyzing player statistics like runs scored, wickets taken in different pitch conditions, and various other relevant factors, this model will provide valuable information to optimize team composition. Also comparing the performance of individuals in ODI and TEST conditions. At present country cricket board has a lot of options or choices because of the great talent and skill of the players. This model focuses on Indian players based on their category of role in the squad. It also makes the task easy for selectors to find the particular player for the required role for example consider batsmen there are different categories like Top Order, Middle Order, Wicketkeeper batsmen, etc. This model shows the compatibility of a particular player in the team based on statistics. The machine learning model that is developed shows the best-fit regression algorithm for players to be selected in ODI and TEST based on the required role needed for the team and also considers the individual player strengths for selecting them in the team. For predicting a player to be contoured in the ODI team algorithms like SVM and Decision Tree produce fewer error results whereas for predicting new players in the TEST team algorithms like LSTM and SVM produce fewer errors. So, the SVM model is the best regression technique for this kind of work.

articleTitle: Schnorr Multi-Signatures with Key Aggregation for Privacy and Verifiable Randomness in Blockchain Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: The absence of privacy and verifiable randomness in blockchain poses security risks such as unauthorized data access and identity theft, especially as the technology gains traction in critical sectors like finance and healthcare. The rapid adoption of blockchain amplifies the urgency to address these vulnerabilities for secure and scalable implementation. This paper confronts the urgent issues of compromised privacy and unverifiable randomness in blockchain systems by introducing the Artificial Intelligence-driven Schnorr Multi-Signature with Key Aggregation (AI-SMKA) approach. This mechanism exhibits a good degree of anonymity and error free key aggregation, desirable for large scale block chain networks. This mechanism is a prospective tool for deployment in sensitive applications towards secured data sharing and digital identity management.

articleTitle: Enhancing Flower Classification Through Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Investigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Flower categorisation is crucial in botanical study, environmental monitoring, and ecological preservation. The ability to classify flowers accurately and effectively has been possible because of the exponential rise of visual data and the development of advanced deep-learning algorithms. To further automate botanical species identification, this investigation of multiple deep-learning methods for classifying flowers is presented in this research paper. We examine the effectiveness of cutting-edge convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and suggest fresh methods to improve their accuracy, resilience, and scalability. Our experimental analyses cover a range of floral datasets, taking into account difficulties including changes in lighting, size, and viewpoint. The results give information on the relative effectiveness of various models and their advantages and disadvantages. This research is expected to enhance botany, promote environmental conservation efforts, and inspire the creation of cutting-edge picture recognition systems as we work to automate the recognition of flower species.

articleTitle: FitCraft - Redefining Tailoring Precision Through Advanced Computer Vision and Machine Learning Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: This proposed project develops a reliable technique for measuring the human body accurately using computer vision and machine learning. Beginning with a heterogeneous dataset, state-of-the-art methods are employed to refine photos and precisely identify body landmarks. Complexities such as pose variations are managed through advanced models. High precision is ensured by error correcting techniques, which also provide reliable outlier rejection. These methods, incorporating machine learning, are applied in a user-friendly program, useful for anthropometric research, health monitoring, and customization. Offering an adaptable resolution for various enterprises, the analysis also looks at how system optimizations impact customer behavior, worker productivity, and physical measurements.

articleTitle: How Robotic Process Automation and Blockchain can Work Together?
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on E-mobility, Power Control and Smart Systems (ICEMPS)
abstract: Exploring the complex terrain of RPA and blockchain integration, this paper uncovers the possibility of groundbreaking results in various sectors. Integrating these innovative technologies creates a historical chance to intensify efficiency, ensure data security, and promote visibility across various organizational processes. Although this synergy comes with technical challenges requiring complete solutions, the paper pinpoints primary difficulties with an exhaustive analysis of technology stacks, data standardization, scalability, smart contract integration, privacy, interoperability, change management, evolving skill sets, and cost elements. An in-depth investigation highlights the vital roles of collaboration, innovation, and interdisciplinary expertise in addressing the challenges. This paper offers a holistic perspective on the obstacles and solutions associated with integrating RPA and blockchain, empowering organizations to execute this integration and unlock its groundbreaking potential seamlessly.

The precision numbers, which range between 95.85% to 98.04%, demonstrate the model's ability to precisely identify cases of each condition and demonstrate its accuracy in reducing false positives.
